issue.title: Agent Hijack: stop a stalled agent, keep its work, recover in one keypress
issue.description: A user can hijack a stalled sase agent (,k, the kill dialog's h, or `sase agent hijack NAME`). Its process tree stops, but its workspace claim, Agents-tab node, and evidence stay. The node shows a ⏏ HIJACKED status, and <enter> opens a single-keypress recovery panel: escalate to a smarter model, continue, or instruct in the same workspace; restart or edit from a fresh workspace after a verified snapshot; view the diff, open a shell, or dismiss. Every path is durable, exactly-once, and fails closed so work is never silently lost.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/agent_hijack.md requests this work
